statement: For the full routed MSSC source object, all retained scalar denominators depend on three independent scalar data u=p0^2, a_s=p0.q_s, a_a=p0.q_a, with a_b=-(a_s+a_a) from q_s+q_a+q_b=0. The single native hard-channel invariant s of Iter205 cannot generically determine these three data without two additional same-parent frozen constraints/invariants.

derivation.rank_argument: A map from generic 3-dimensional invariant data (u,a_s,a_a) to one scalar s has 2-dimensional level sets generically. Therefore s alone cannot uniquely fix all D_A or their roots/Jacobians. A unique D_A(s) requires two additional independently frozen same-parent constraints or invariants held fixed by the native D_s protocol.
derivation.delta_pullback_requirement: delta(D_A) -> sum delta(s-s_*)/|partial_s D_A| is defined only after u(s), a_s(s), a_a(s), or equivalent two auxiliary constraints plus the s trajectory, are frozen.

forbidden_shortcuts: Iter588 isolated symmetric routing substituted into the full Iter594/605 object
post-hoc choice of two auxiliary constraints
next_gate: Recover or prospectively derive from the same parent source-completed/native dynamics the two additional invariant constraints held fixed while Iter205 D_s varies s, equivalently a one-parameter hard-channel trajectory (u(s),a_s(s),a_a(s)). Freeze it before any pole projection; then derive family roots/Jacobians and bind to native Y/T_cut.
